scientific_integrity: Exact proof uses a factor-gap covering lemma, explicit attractors, four disjoint unique-factor intervals, and composition enumeration. Standalone Python verification checks finite cases but is not an infinite proof. No external independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to \(0\,1^b0^c1\,0^e\) with positive b,c,e. The two-versus-three distinction remains unresolved. The asymptotic frequency is conditional on this family and originality is subject to unindexed prior literature. Independent scientific audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp four-position attractor criterion for a five-run binary family
